verdict.rationale: Docusign's official MCP connector lets an agent query agreement status and key dates, retrieve agreement metadata, and trigger IAM workflow actions (docusign-docs-47, docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-docs-39, docusign-probe-3). Gemini CLI pairing for querying agreement data and automating agreement processes (docusign-intdir-4) and the REST API with OpenAPI specs (docusign-docs-21, docusign-gh-1) add further programmatic access. However, nothing documents renewal-specific tracking, deadline alerts, or event-driven monitoring, so the agent would have to poll key dates and supply its own scheduling logic. Missing for 10: documented renewal/expiration tracking, webhook or event notifications for upcoming deadlines, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven renewal workflows.
